answer: A claimant stakes a 70-credit bond, filing a sighting at the jetty: the farthest post where the lantern stays visible in the zephyr. The board publishes candlepower/fog logs, so a jetty auditor recomputes the range for that zephyr. Over-range filings or reused lantern flash timestamps burn the bond. Fees start at 39, up 5 per identity: the kth fake pays 39+5(k-1), the 1000th 5034, and 1000 fakes cost 2,536,500 plus 70,000 locked. A rented-sightline ring copying posts fails: one filing per window, duplicates burn both bonds. Honest claimants pay 39 once and reclaim it.
